assets.name: cx-emblem
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production application icon and brand mark for CX Launcher, a futuristic Windows game library.
Primary request: one premium sculpted chrome emblem: a clean open hexagonal portal shaped subtly like a C, with a compact diagonal X energy core in its center. This is a new icon, not a screenshot or UI mockup.
Style: precise industrial 3D icon, orthographic front view with very shallow depth, crisp broad beveled edges and a simple strong silhouette readable at 32 pixels. Brushed silver and dark titanium, restrained electric icy-blue #79BCFF edge illumination and a small violet #9D8DFF inner accent. Balanced and confident technology aesthetic.
Composition: single centered emblem occupying about 76% of a square canvas, generous clear transparent margin; completely isolated on a genuinely transparent background.
Constraints: no green, no teal, no cyan-green; no text, letters, slogans, numbers, watermark, surrounding plate, scene, particles, extra ornaments or long glow. Keep only the emblem with tight subtle highlights. Preserve true alpha transparency.
